title: Azure SQL Database - Simply Explained
description:
Running your own database server means patching, backups and late-night failovers. This beginner-friendly episode explains Azure SQL Database: how the DTU and vCore models differ, which tier to pick, when elastic pools and serverless save money, and how backups and security work by default. You'll know when to choose the managed service and when a virtual machine is the better fit.
In this episode
00:00 – What Azure SQL Database is02:22 – DTU vs vCore purchasing models04:12 – Picking your service tier06:03 – Elastic pools07:28 – Backups and high availability09:31 – Security without the jargon11:08 – Managed database or virtual machine12:42 – Beginner mistakes and wrap-up
Key takeaways
Azure SQL Database runs the familiar SQL Server engine as a managed service, so patching, backups and high availability become Microsoft's job.Choose between the simple DTU bundle and the flexible vCore model, start small, and use serverless or elastic pools only for intermittent or spiky workloads.Safe settings such as a closed firewall and encryption at rest are the defaults, so your main job is controlling who gets in, ideally with Entra ID.
Worth quoting
“You aren't renting a box and doing the work yourself. You're renting an outcome and someone else keeps the lights on.” – Mirko Peters (00:44)
“The rule of thumb that saves beginners a lot of stress is this start small, watch the numbers and grow later.” – Mirko Peters (05:50)
Explore more on M365.FM
Episode page: the full episode with chapters, quotes and an FAQ on Azure SQL DatabaseMicrosoft Azure – the cloud where Microsoft runs the SQL Server engine as a managed database serviceMicrosoft Entra ID – the recommended sign-in option for Azure SQL Database instead of plain SQL usernames and passwordsMultifactor authentication (MFA) – one of the protections you gain by signing in to the database with Entra IDConditional Access – rules that apply to database sign-ins once you use Entra ID authenticationRelated episode: Microsoft Entra ID Protection - Simply Explained
